title: 16-card operational-gap adjudication
root_cause: Sixteen non-final operational cards had strong historical behavior evidence without a current-source successor binding.
source_requirement: Classify each named card independently without upgrading historical evidence into current proof.
implementation_steps: Bind historical final82 evidence to its exact old identity.
Assign a current disposition and successor proof obligation.
negative_cases: Do not bulk-close cards from aggregate control evidence.
Do not discard historical installed evidence.
evidence_required: One disposition for each of the 16 required card IDs.
rollback: Restore only the audit projection; never rewrite ledger history.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 cards are accounted for exactly once.
Every card retains its current ledger state and explicit proof obligation.
